messages:
emily.g: Quick sync — planning to launch the Q3 remarketing creative rotation next Tue 9am PT. Need final go on creatives + budget pacing.

matt.k: Links look good. baseline CPA for retargeting is ~ $18. What are targets?

emily.g: Target CPA $12-15. Start at 30% of total retarget budget, rotate creatives every 48h. Scale if CTR > 1.8% and CPA <= $15.

jana_pm: Can we keep a control creative for A/B? Also want to test messaging: benefit-forward vs ROI-forward.

oliver_ads: I'll set this up in Google Ads. Proposed config:
```
campaign: Q3_Remarketing_Refresh
budget/day: $1,200
bidding: target CPA $14
audience windows: 7d / 14d / 30d
creative rotation: custom (rotate every 48h)
dayparting: 9am-6pm PT weekdays = +15% bid
UTM: utm_source=google&utm_medium=remarketing&utm_campaign=q3_remarketing_refresh
```

ads-bot: Creative upload complete — 6 assets (3 static, 3 short vids). Preview: https://assets.redwood.ai/creatives/q3-remarket (uploaded by oliver_ads) :sparkles:

emily.g: Nice — matt, can you sign off on the pacing plan? We want gradual ramp: 20% day1, 35% day3, 50% day7, then scale if metrics look good.

matt.k: :thumbsup: Approve the pacing. Add alert if CPA > $25 for 6h window. Also strongly prefer keep control creative pinned as jana requested.

sarah_growth: Landing page variant B updated headline to match ROI creative. URL: https://redwood.ai/landing?variant=B — matches messaging and tracking events.

jana_pm: Small experiment request: swap CTA copy 'Start free' vs 'See pricing' as a sub-test on retargeted users. Track conv rate and pricing views.

oliver_ads: Experiment created. I'll push audience splits and creative rotation rules tonight. KPI dashboard will feed this sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q2w3e-example (I set up columns: date, spend, impressions, ctr, cpa, conv_rate).

emily.g: Also add analytics annotations for key events: signup_trial, pricing_view, embed_generation. Please add alert: notify #marketing if CPA spikes > $25 or CTR drops below 0.8% for 12h.

matt.k: Adding alert rule now. Who's owning the creative copy tweaks? @creative-team — we might need minor CTA variants.

emily.g: No major tweaks expected. If anything, swap headline for one asset in first 48h based on early CTR.

ads-bot: Reminder set — Launch scheduled for 1955630400 (Tue 09:00 PT). I'll post a launch notification in #marketing and ping @ops and @sales on go-live.

emily.g: Perfect. I'll publish a short brief and post assets in the campaign folder after final checks. Thanks everyone.
